notes.title: Cyberless: Online (Yama 25.04.2024.0) has been released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312569/d8d1f24c3470e7a8ec99e64e0e2f2401aaef2cf9.png[/img]

• As we say, we're continue to improve our game as a team. We share with you the latest changes, we have made on our game and look forward to your comments and suggestions about the changes.

• Follow and contact us on [url=https://discord.gg/RtKCBfQYfj]Discord[/url] for the latest game updates and announcements.

[h1][b]Latest Changes:[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]Added:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added DLSS, FSR and Intel XeSS integration.
[*] Added new main menu map.
[*] Added 2 new training maps.
[*] Added turkish language into options.
[*] Added new loading and startup screens.
[*] Added connection dialog.
[*] Added password dialog.
[*] Added bullet tracer effect.
[*] Added idle kick system.
[*] Added new damage indicator.
[*] Added in-game party system.
[*] Added new interface sounds.
[*] Added gun and surface sounds.
[*] Added new characters and weapons.
[*] Added invitation system to the game.
[*] Added crosshair customizations into settings.
[*] Added new gun shooting and camera systems.
[*] Added damage reaction animations.
[*] Added blood effect.
[*] Added spectator cameras.
[*] Added bullet holes and blade damage marks.
[*] Added bullet impact particles.
[*] Added in-game text and voice chat.
[*] Added tool change feature.
[*] Added deathmatch game mode.
[*] Added Penetration system.
[*] Added new MVP screen.
[*] Added new killcam system.
[*] Added death information interface.
[*] Added camera shake.
[*] Added overhead displays that show teammate details.
[*] Added enemy model edge brightness.
[*] Added new recoil system.
[*] Added new interface for replay system.
[/list]
 [h3][b]Fixed Issues:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the problem of not being able to join the lobby.
[*] Fixed killcam problem.
[*] Fixed the issue where mouse control sensitivity started at "0".
[*] Fixed the issue of score values ​​falling below zero.
[*] Fixed the problem of unnecessary deaths in training maps.
[*] Fixed bugs in weapon inspection animations.
[*] Fixed end-game actions (return to main menu, switch to new lobby, etc.) not working properly.
[*] Fixed gun animation and animation image problem.
[*] Fixed the issue where crosshairs would be deleted when targeted.
[*] Fixed the game ends when the target score is reached.
[*] Fixed main menu performance issue.
[*] Fixed TPS weapon accessory issues.
[*] Fixed automatic magazine and magazine changing problem.
[*] Fixed left hand system.
[*] Fixed crouch and smooth camera problems.
[*] Fixed character and owned weapon model visibility problems.
[/list]
[h3][b]Improvements:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Warehouse and Armada maps have been updated.
[*] Map optimization increased.
[*] The targeting system has been improved.
[*] Hand and arm images have been improved.
[*] Game feel has been improved.
[*] The distance and proximity of the sounds have been adjusted.
[*] Updated scoreboard.
[*] Deathnotice style changed.
[/list]

[h1][h2][b]Latest Changes:[/b][/h2][/h1]
[list]

[*] Added Hit-Response animations.
[*] Crosshair centered.
[*] Added indicators of damage caused and received.

[*] Added the feature of deactivating the death screen on servers (when launching the server, just give ?NoKillcam parameter to map. Example: /Game/Maps/Training?NoKillcam?TimeLimit=0)

[*] Added minimap.
[*] Added compass.

[/list]

[h1][h2][b]Latest Changes:[/b][/h2][/h1]
[list]

[*] Now the system divides the players equally into teams when you enter the game.
[*] Added new firing system (Preliminary for a planned game mode).
[*] Fixed an issue where "TOO_MUCH_AGGRESSIVE_BEHAVIOR" was not displayed when banned from server due to aggressive behavior.
[*] The problem that no message appears on the screen when trying to log in to the server that has been banned due to aggressive behavior has been resolved.
[*] Added Crosshair settings.
[*] Fixed bugs in resolution settings (not the same for Vulkan).
[*] Added Controls settings.
[*] Added weapon switching with scroll.

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312569/c062d0ffc11b18315edf4fc4ecae62a04da82964.png[/img]

notes.title: Cyberless III: Online (Pack 02.03.2022.0) has been released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312569/341616642d2fdffe610085135c0f758bf294531a.png[/img]

• As we say, we're continue to improve our game as a team. We share with you the latest changes, we have made on our game and look forward to your comments and suggestions about the changes.

• Follow and contact us on [url=https://discord.gg/RtKCBfQYfj]Discord[/url] for the latest game updates and announcements.

[h1][h2][b]Latest Changes:[/b][/h2][/h1]
[list] 

[*]  The design error in the wrong password menu has been resolved.
[*] Friendly fire system has been added in team play.
[*] Added Overtime match time feature.
[*] Added ability to skip Killcam screen.
[*] Design changes have been made in the end-of-match screen.
[*] Fixed the problem of not being able to choose a team automatically when the game restarts.
[*] Ping measurement system has been changed.
[*] When exiting the game, the character commits suicide instead of being deleted.
[*] Deals damage when climbing on top of another player.
[*] Added aggressive behavior mode.
[*] Added Linux Server to DockerHub (Now it is easier to set up a server, click for detailed [url=https://hub.docker.com/r/teamcyberless/cyberless3onlineserver]information[/url]).
[*] Errors that will occur on Linux servers have been added back to the error scope. (Only valid for Linux Server. We are not able to provide support for errors you have received through Linux Client yet.)
[*] Fixed in-game settings not saving issue.

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312569/c062d0ffc11b18315edf4fc4ecae62a04da82964.png[/img]
